svg.title: Installing only the AI agent files (agent mode) — Saying no to the full framework installs only the AI agent files
svg.text: Installing only the AI agent files (agent mode)
Scenario: Saying no to the full framework installs only the AI agent files

g.text: Given a fresh GitLab project with only a README on its main branch
GitLab's page for the main branch of a brand-new project. The Files panel on the left lists one file, README.md, and the table shows it on the commit "Initial commit".
Dates, avatars and the project's random name are hidden, so the picture is the same on every run.
When the developer starts the installer and turns down the complete
framework, a checklist opens with the AI agent line already ticked
The terminal, from the typed installer command down. The installer explains its two choices,
"Complete framework" and "Pick components". The developer turns down the complete framework,
the yes/no question clears itself, and a checklist opens.
Its first line, "Agent mode", is already ticked, so pressing Enter installs the AI agent
Then the installer installs only the AI agent files
The same terminal once the install is over. The installer says "Agent mode installed." and
"Installed the AI agent context: .agent/, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md.", then gives the prompt
And after one push to the main branch, GitLab shows the AI agent files beside the README and nothing else
The same GitLab page as the first card, after one push to the main branch. The table now lists .agent, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md on the commit "chore: install the AI agent guardrails", and
The Files panel opens .agent to show the rules and skills it holds. Agent mode pushes straight to the main branch, with no merge request.

text.tspan: git add -A && git commit -q -m "chore: install the AI agent guardrails" && git push -q origin main
